rounds.text: The market is severely under-appreciating a dramatic turnaround in profitability, evidenced by a robust 28% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E17] and accelerating earnings growth [E50]. This surging profitability has triggered a positive price-led signal where recent profit growth exceeds one-year price growth by 36%, demonstrating that the company is beginning to outperform market expectations [E41]. Furthermore, this momentum is supported by a solid sector tailwind featuring a sector median profit growth of 22.1% [E54] and a respectable return on equity of 7.37% [E8]. Conceded: [E11].

Operational efficiency is virtually non-existent, highlighted by a staggering Return on Assets (ROA) of -129.41% compared to a healthy sector benchmark of 4.95% [E7]. Top-line contraction is severe and persistent across all measured horizons, with compounded sales growth plunging by -27% over 10 years, -20% over 5 years, and accelerating downward to -45% over the last 3 years [E11, E12, E13]. This structural revenue decay is compounded by a recent 3-year profit growth contraction of -45% [E16] and an unprofitable P/E ratio of -59.79x against a profitable sector benchmark of 23.4x [E5]. Furthermore, the company offers a complete dividend yield of 0.00% [E3] and was explicitly flagged for delivering poor 5-year sales growth [E44]. The bull argues that a P/B ratio of 0x [E6] indicates a valuation distortion rather than operational failure, but this ignores the filed statements showing a deeply negative book value of ₹ -19.8 and a price-to-book of -4.20x [E1], which explicitly points to severe balance sheet destruction.
